items.reason: Identifies the same incorrect && permission check that rejects team admins; changing it to OR fixes the issue.
Explicitly identifies the case-sensitive blacklist bypass and fixes it by normalizing guest emails. It also covers the existing-attendee deduplication problem described in #05.

Claims new guests are absent from the email event, but the handler builds its attendees from the updated booking, including newly inserted guests. This differs from #06, which concerns existing attendees being misclassified through the raw guests argument.

Describes an unguarded attendees[0] access, which no golden issue covers. The normal add-guests flow supplies at least one newly inserted attendee, so the proposed empty-array scenario is not established by that flow.
